page1.title: A Little Piece of My Heart
page1.subtitle: For the girl who makes my world a little more beautiful.
paragraphs: Happy Birthday,my love,my dearest Nabuu. I hope today brings you as much happiness as you bring into my life.You deserve all the love, peace, and beautiful things this world has to offer.

I may not always find the perfect words to express how much you mean to me, but I hope you never doubt how special you are to me. I'm really lucky to have you, and I hope I get to make countless more memories with you.
page1.sign: If I had to choose again, in every lifetime, I'd still choose you.

last.title: One last thing....
paragraphs:
No matter how many birthdays pass, I hope I get to be there to celebrate every single one of them with you.
If I had to choose again, in every lifetime, I'd still choose you.
Happy Birthday, my favourite person. Keep smiling, my Fairyyy Nabu. I love you more than words can ever explain. ❤️
And always remember, I love youu more than anything and anyone and I will always keep loving and admiring you till my last breath.
